meta.name: humanizer
meta.description:
Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing
text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's
comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including:
inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague
attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive
voice, negative parallelisms, and filler phrases.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把AI腔调改写为自然表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需把AI生成的内容改成自然语气
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite AI-sounding text into natural human writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make AI-generated text sound more natural

howto.what: 把人工智能写出来的文字改得更像真人手写：识别并消除夸大、宣传腔、滥用破折号等常见痕迹，同时保留原意，不添加原文没有的事实。如果你提供自己的写作样本，它会模仿你的行文习惯。
howto.when: 当你编辑或审阅文本，希望它更自然、更像人写时触发；若你提供自己的写作样本，它也会据此调整风格。

say.text: 请把这段文字改得像人写的，别那么像机器生成的。
say.note: 它会去除 AI 痕迹并重写。

say.text: 帮我审这段，把宣传腔和破折号都清理掉。
say.note: 它会重点修正这两类问题。

say.text: 这是我的文风样本，照这个风格重写下面这段。
say.note: 它会先分析样本，再按你的风格改写。

howto.what_en: Rewrites AI text to sound human: detects and removes common tells (puffery, promo tone, em dashes, etc.), keeps the meaning, adds no facts. With a writing sample, it imitates your style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're editing or reviewing text and want it to sound more natural and human-written; if you provide a writing sample, it also adjusts its style to match.

say_en.text: Please rewrite this text to sound human-written, not so machine-generated.
Review this passage and clean up the promotional tone and em dashes.
say_en.note: It focuses on fixing these two patterns.

say_en.text: Here's a sample of my writing style; rewrite the following in this style.
say_en.note: It analyzes the sample first, then mimics it.
